name: Right of Abode

requirement_groups.name: Ghanaian descendant who lost citizenship by acquiring foreign nationality

requirements.blocker_text: Lost Ghanaian citizenship by reason of acquiring a foreign nationality.
Requires attestation from two Ghanaians (notaries, lawyers, or senior officials) and police clearance from Ghana.

requirement_groups.name: Person of African descent living outside Ghana

requirements.blocker_text: Must be a person of African descent living outside Ghana, sponsored, with written attestation from two reputable Ghanaians.
Must show evidence of economic contribution to Ghana (investments, employment creation, bank statements), including 3 years of audited company accounts and 6 years of tax clearance where applicable.
requirements.fix_path: Establish a documented investment/business presence in Ghana with the required financial history.

evidence_required.document: Birth certificate and renunciation certificate (Ghanaian-descendant track)
Written attestation from two reputable Ghanaians
3 years' audited accounts and 6 years' tax clearance (African-diaspora economic-contribution track)
Medical report from a Ghana Immigration Service clinic

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service -- Right of Abode: for (1) persons who lost Ghanaian citizenship by acquiring a foreign nationality, and (2) persons of African descent living outside Ghana; grants the right to reside permanently in Ghana, enter without a visa, and work or be employed without a work permit; requires attestation from two reputable Ghanaians, Ghana police clearance, and (African-diaspora track) documented evidence of economic contribution including audited accounts and tax clearance history

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ghana). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Ghana Immigration Service). MARQUEE ROUTE, GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE IN THIS DATASET: Right of Abode is a formal, named legal status specifically extended to 'persons of African descent living outside Ghana' -- not just former Ghanaian citizens or their direct descendants, but the wider African diaspora (including African-Americans, Caribbean nationals, and other diaspora communities with no documentable Ghanaian ancestry at all). This is the legal backbone behind Ghana's well-publicized diaspora-engagement initiatives (the 2019 'Year of Return' marking 400 years since the first enslaved Africans arrived in Virginia, and the ongoing 'Beyond the Return' program) -- Right of Abode is the closest thing in this dataset to a country extending a path to permanent legal status on the basis of shared ancestry to an entire diaspora rather than a specific documented family lineage. work_rights set to 'full' since the government's own page explicitly states holders may 'work or be employed without a work permit' -- a genuine, sourced full-rights grant, not this dataset's usual conservative default for ancestry-based statuses. Duration described as indefinite based on the 'reside permanently' language, though no explicit renewal/validity period was stated in the source. Distinct from gh_citizenship_by_descent.json and gh_citizenship_naturalisation.json -- Right of Abode does not itself confer Ghanaian citizenship.
